p5.q: The new software allows employees to track their expenses more ______.
p5.exp: more 後面修飾動詞 track，要用副詞 efficiently（更有效率地）。efficient 是形容詞；efficiency、efficiencies 是名詞。

p5.q: Ms. Han's ______ to the project was praised by the entire team.
p5.exp: 所有格 Ms. Han's 後面接名詞，而且是句子的主詞：contribution（貢獻）。contribute 是動詞原形；contributed、contributing 不能接在所有格後面當主詞。

p5.q: All visitors must wear ______ identification badges while on the factory floor.
p5.exp: 名詞片語 identification badges 前面要形容詞：visible（看得見的、明顯的）。visibly 是副詞；visibility 是名詞；visualize 是動詞。

p5.q: The board will vote on the proposal after a ______ review of the budget.
p5.exp: 冠詞 a 和名詞 review 之間要形容詞：thorough（徹底的）。thoroughly、more thoroughly 是副詞；thoroughness 是名詞。

p5.q: Customer complaints have decreased ______ since the company introduced its online chat service.
p5.exp: 修飾動詞 have decreased，要用副詞 significantly（大幅地）。significant 是形容詞；significance 是名詞；signify 是動詞。

p5.q: The museum's new wing is expected to attract a ______ number of tourists.
p5.exp: a ___ number of 中間要形容詞，表示「相當多的」：considerable。considerate 也是形容詞，但意思是「體貼的」，不能修飾 number；considerably 是副詞；consideration 是名詞。

p5.q: Please read the safety instructions ______ before operating the machine.
p5.exp: 修飾動詞 read，要用副詞 carefully（仔細地）。careful 是形容詞；care 是名詞或動詞；cared 是過去式。

p5.q: The company's ______ in the Asian market has exceeded expectations.
p5.exp: 所有格 The company's 後面接名詞當主詞：expansion（擴張）。expand 是動詞；expanded 是過去式或過去分詞；expansive 是形容詞。

p5.q: The conference room is unavailable ______ noon and 2 P.M. on Thursday.
p5.exp: between A and B（在 A 和 B 之間）。from 要搭配 to；during、throughout 後面接一段期間的名詞，不接 A and B。

p5.q: Ms. Patel will be responsible ______ training the new sales staff.
p5.exp: be responsible for（負責某事）是固定搭配。be responsible to 是「對某人負責」，後面接人，不接 training。

p5.q: The shipment was delayed ______ a shortage of trucks.
p5.exp: 後面是名詞片語 a shortage of trucks，又表示原因，用介係詞片語 because of。although、so that 是連接詞，後面要接子句；in spite of 意思相反（儘管）。

p5.q: The library is located ______ the street from the city hall.
p5.exp: across the street from（在…的對街）是固定說法。through、along、over 都不能和 the street from 搭配出這個意思。

p5.q: Registration for the workshop must be completed ______ October 15.
p5.exp: 截止期限用 by（在…之前完成）。until 表示動作持續到某時，和「完成」不搭；within 後面接一段時間（within two weeks）；since 要搭配完成式。

p5.q: The marketing team will ______ the results of the survey at next week's meeting.
p5.exp: 在會議上「報告、提出」調查結果：present。attend 是「參加」，受詞要是會議；appear、occur 是不及物動詞，不能接受詞。

p5.q: Due to high demand, the new model is currently out of ______.
p5.exp: 需求很高，所以「缺貨」：out of stock。out of order 是「故障」；out of service 是「停止運作」；out of place 是「格格不入」，都不符合需求高的語意。

p5.q: The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle service to guests who ______ a room for three nights or more.
p5.exp: 預訂房間：reserve。conserve（節約）、preserve（保存）、deserve（應得）字形相近，但意思不合。

p5.q: Mr. Ito was promoted to regional manager in ______ of his outstanding sales record.
p5.exp: in recognition of（表彰、肯定…）是固定片語：因為業績優異而升職。in admission of、in reputation of、in attention of 都不是正確的片語。

p5.q: Before signing the contract, please make sure that all the ______ are correct.
p5.exp: 簽約前確認所有「細節」正確：details。detours（繞道）、debates（辯論）、devices（裝置）都不能形容合約內容是否正確。

p5.q: The factory has been running at full ______ since it received the large order.
p5.exp: at full capacity（滿載、全力生產）是固定搭配。full possibility、full quality、full quantity 都不是這個意思的說法。

p5.q: Employees are ______ to submit their travel expenses within thirty days.
p5.exp: be required to（被要求、必須）。be considered to 是「被認為」；proposed 不用 be proposed to do 表示規定；insist 要接 on，沒有 be insisted to 的用法。

p5.q: ______ the weather was poor, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
p5.exp: 天氣不好，音樂會卻照常舉行，前後是讓步關係：Although（雖然）。Because 表示原因，語意相反；Unless（除非）和 Provided that（只要）都不合。

p5.q: The report will be distributed to all staff ______ it has been approved by the director.
p5.exp: 「一旦」主管核准就發給所有人：once。while 表示同時或對比；unless（除非）會變成「除非已核准才不發」，語意不合；whereas 表示對比。

p5.q: Customers can pay ______ by credit card or by bank transfer.
p5.exp: either A or B（A 或 B 擇一）。both 要搭配 and；neither 要搭配 nor；whether A or B 用在子句（不管是…還是…），不能直接接在 pay 後面表示付款方式。

p5.q: The candidate ______ we interviewed yesterday has accepted our offer.
p5.exp: 先行詞是人（The candidate），在關係子句中當 interviewed 的受詞：whom。whose 後面要接名詞；what 不能有先行詞；which 不能指人。

p5.q: The supplier, ______ prices are the lowest in the region, has been our partner for ten years.
p5.exp: 空格後面直接接名詞 prices（供應商的價格），表示所有關係：whose。who、which 後面要接動詞或缺主詞／受詞的子句；that 不能用在逗號後的非限定子句。

p5.q: By the time the new manager arrives next month, the renovation ______.
p5.exp: By the time + 未來的時間點（下個月經理到任時），主要子句用未來完成式；整修是被完成，所以是被動：will have been completed。

p5.q: Mr. Lopez ______ for the company for fifteen years before he retired last spring.
p5.exp: 退休（去年春天）是過去的事，在那之前已經工作了十五年：過去完成式 had worked。has worked、has been working 是現在完成式，不能搭配已經退休的過去時間點。

p5.q: The documents ______ to the application must be signed by a supervisor.
p5.exp: 文件是「被附上」的，用過去分詞 attached 修飾 documents（＝documents that are attached）。attaching 是主動；attach 是動詞原形；attachment 是名詞。

p5.q: Ms. Chen prefers to review the contracts ______ rather than rely on her assistant.
p5.exp: 強調「親自」審閱，用反身代名詞 herself。her、hers 放在句尾不能表示「自己親自」；themselves 是複數，和 Ms. Chen 不一致。

p5.q: This year's sales figures are ______ than those of any previous year.
p5.exp: 後面有 than，要用比較級；high 是單音節形容詞，比較級是 higher。highest 是最高級；more high 不是正確形式。

p6.title: 電子郵件：辦公室搬遷
p6.text:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Department
Subject: Office move

As you know, our team will move to the new building on Grant Street next month. To make the transition as smooth as possible, we ask that you ___[1]___ your personal belongings by Friday, March 7. Boxes and labels will be ___[2]___ at the front desk starting Monday. ___[3]___

The movers will transport all furniture and computer equipment over the weekend. ___[4]___, please contact Ana Ruiz at extension 214.

blanks.exp: ask that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（假設語氣）：we ask that you pack。packed、packing、to pack 都不能放在 that 子句的主詞 you 後面當動詞。
be 動詞後面接形容詞：will be available（可以取得）。availability 是名詞；avail 是動詞；availably 不是常用字。

opts: Please write your name and new desk number on each box.
The new building has a large cafeteria on the top floor.
Last year's move was postponed because of bad weather.
Staff parking will cost ten dollars per day.
blanks.exp: 句子插入題：前一句說櫃台會發箱子和標籤，接著說明標籤要寫什麼（姓名和新座位號碼）最連貫。餐廳、去年延期、停車費都和打包的指示無關。
後面是 please contact…（請聯絡…），前面需要一個條件：If you have any questions（如果有任何問題）。Even so（即便如此）、As a result（結果）、In addition（此外）都不能引出「請聯絡某人」。

p6.title: 廣告：烹飪學校週末課程
p6.text:
Riverside Cooking School is pleased to announce a new series of weekend classes for beginners. Each class is ___[1]___ by a professional chef and lasts three hours. Participants will learn basic knife skills, simple sauces, and ___[2]___ to plan balanced meals.

All ingredients and equipment are provided. ___[3]___ Class sizes are limited to twelve students, so early registration is ___[4]___ recommended.

blanks.exp: 課程是「被教授」的，is + 過去分詞的被動：is taught by a professional chef。teaching 會變成課程在教別人；teach 和 teacher 不能接在 is 後面。
learn how to plan（學習如何規劃）。what to plan 是「規劃什麼」，和後面的 balanced meals 不搭；which、why 也不合。

opts: Students simply need to bring an apron.
Our restaurant is open every evening except Monday.
The school was founded by two brothers in 1998.
Advanced classes require a written test.
blanks.exp: 句子插入題：前一句說食材和器材都由學校提供，接著說「學生只要帶圍裙」最連貫。文中沒有提到餐廳；學校歷史和進階班考試都和初學者課程的準備無關。
修飾形容詞 recommended，要用副詞：strongly recommended（強烈建議）。strong 是形容詞；strength 是名詞；strengthen 是動詞。

p6.title: 報導：麵包店獲獎
p6.text:
MAPLETON (April 2) — Golden Crust Bakery has won this year's Best Small Business award from the Mapleton Chamber of Commerce. The bakery, which opened just three years ago, was ___[1]___ for its use of local ingredients and its support of community events. ___[2]___

Owner Lena Fischer said she was surprised by the news. "We are a small team, and every one of us works hard," she said. "This award really belongs to my staff."

Ms. Fischer plans to use the prize money to ___[3]___ a second oven, which will allow the bakery to increase production. The award ceremony will be held on April 20 at the Mapleton Hotel, and tickets are available to the ___[4]___.

blanks.exp: 麵包店是「被表揚」的，was + 過去分詞的被動：was recognized for…。recognizing 是主動；recognition 是名詞；recognize 是原形。

opts: Every Saturday, it donates unsold bread to a local shelter.
The Chamber of Commerce was established in 1952.
Bread prices have risen across the region this year.
Ms. Fischer previously worked as an accountant.
blanks.exp: 句子插入題：前一句說獲獎原因之一是支持社區活動，接著舉例「每週六把沒賣完的麵包捐給收容所」最連貫。商會成立年份、麵包漲價都離題；Fischer 女士在下一段才第一次出現，這裡先用 Ms. Fischer 稱呼不合理。
to 後面接原形動詞：to purchase a second oven（購買第二台烤箱）。purchasing、purchased 不能接在不定詞 to 後面；purchaser 是名詞（買方）。
the public（一般大眾）是固定說法：門票開放大眾購買。publicly 是副詞；publicity 是名詞（宣傳），和 available to 不搭；publish 是動詞。

p6.title: 備忘錄：新的報帳系統
p6.text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Finance Department
Date: May 12

Starting June 1, all travel expenses must be submitted through ExpenseNow, our new online system. The system will replace the paper forms that we ___[1]___ for the past ten years.

With ExpenseNow, you can photograph receipts with your phone and submit claims in minutes. ___[2]___, reimbursements will be processed within five business days instead of three weeks.

Training sessions will be held next week in Room 4B. ___[3]___ Employees who cannot attend may watch a recorded version on the company intranet. Paper forms will no longer be accepted ___[4]___ May 31.

blanks.exp: for the past ten years（過去十年來）搭配現在完成式：have used。use 是現在簡單式；will use 是未來式；are using 是現在進行式，都不能和 for the past ten years 搭配。
前一句說新系統的好處（用手機拍收據、幾分鐘就能申請），這句再加一個好處（五個工作天內撥款），用 In addition（此外）。However 表示轉折；Otherwise（否則）、For example（例如）都不合。

opts: Each session will last about forty-five minutes.
Receipts must be kept for seven years.
Our travel policy has not changed since 2015.
blanks.exp: 句子插入題：前一句說下週在 4B 室舉辦訓練課程，接著說明每場課程的長度最連貫。4B 室正在整修，和在那裡上課矛盾；收據保存年限和差旅政策都離題。
「5 月 31 日之後」不再接受紙本表格：no longer… after May 31。until 搭配 no longer 會變成「到 5 月 31 日為止不再接受」，語意不合；since 要搭配完成式；during 後面接一段期間。

p7.title: 單篇：停車場關閉公告
passages:
NOTICE: PARKING GARAGE CLOSURE

The underground parking garage at Lakeview Tower will be closed on Saturday, September 9, and Sunday, September 10, while the floors are resurfaced and the parking lines are repainted.

During the closure, tenants may park free of charge at the Elm Street public lot, two blocks east of the building. Please display your Lakeview Tower parking permit on your dashboard.

Vehicles left in the garage after 8:00 P.M. on Friday, September 8, will be towed at the owner's expense.

Lakeview Tower Management

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To introduce new monthly parking fees for tenants
To advertise a new parking lot
qs.exp: 公告說停車場週末要重鋪地面、重畫停車格而關閉＝暫時的維修工程。

qs.q: What are tenants asked to do?
opts: Show a permit when parking elsewhere
Pay for parking at the Elm Street lot
Move their cars by Saturday afternoon
Contact management for a temporary pass
qs.exp: 在 Elm Street 停車場免費停車，但要把大樓的停車證放在儀表板上＝出示停車證。是免費的，不用付費；車子要在週五晚上八點前移走。

p7.title: 單篇：簡訊對話（意圖題）
passages:
Paulo Mendes [10:12 A.M.]
Hi, Grace. The printer just told me the brochures for the trade show won't be ready until Thursday.

Grace Kim [10:13 A.M.]
Thursday? We're leaving for Chicago on Wednesday morning.

Paulo Mendes [10:14 A.M.]
I know. They offered to ship them straight to the convention center instead.

Grace Kim [10:16 A.M.]
That works. Our booth doesn't open until Friday.

Paulo Mendes [10:17 A.M.]
Great. I'll give them the address and ask for a tracking number.

qs.q: What problem does Mr. Mendes report?
opts: Some printed materials will be delayed
A flight to Chicago was canceled
A booth at the trade show has not been reserved yet
qs.exp: 印刷廠說商展用的型錄週四才會好＝印刷品延遲。

qs.q: At 10:16 A.M., what does Ms. Kim mean when she writes, "That works"?
opts: She agrees with a suggested solution
She thinks a machine is working again
She will work at the booth on Friday
She approves a new brochure design
qs.exp: 意圖題：印刷廠提議直接寄到會展中心，她說 That works，接著說攤位週五才開＝同意這個解決辦法。不是說機器修好了。

p7.title: 單篇：搬家公司廣告
passages:
SWIFT MOVERS — Moving made simple

Whether you are moving across town or across the country, Swift Movers has the experience to get you there safely. Our services include:
• Packing and unpacking
• Furniture assembly
• Short-term storage (up to 60 days)

All moves are fully insured. Book before the end of this month and receive 15% off any move of more than 100 kilometers.

For a free estimate, call 555-0142 or visit swiftmovers.com. A member of our team will visit your home within 48 hours.

qs.q: What service does Swift Movers offer?
qs.exp: 服務項目有 Short-term storage (up to 60 days)＝短期存放物品。只有短期，最多 60 天，不是長期倉庫出租。

qs.q: How can customers receive a discount?
opts: By booking a long-distance move this month
By requesting a free estimate online
By moving to an address within the same city
qs.exp: 本月底前預訂、搬家距離超過 100 公里打 85 折＝本月預訂長途搬家。同城搬家不符合 100 公里的條件。

p7.title: 單篇：訂購收據
passages:
OFFICE PLUS — Order Receipt
Order number: 48213
Date: October 3
Customer: Hanover Legal Services

Item / Quantity / Price
Printer paper (box of 10 reams) / 3 / $105.00
Blue ink cartridges / 4 / $96.00
Desk organizers / 6 / (back-ordered)
Subtotal: $201.00
Business customer discount (10%): -$20.10
Total: $180.90

Note: The desk organizers ($54.00) are currently out of stock and will be shipped separately by October 17. They are not included in the total above; you will be charged when they ship.

qs.q: What is indicated about Hanover Legal Services?
opts: It ordered six boxes of paper
It paid for all items in advance
It will pick up the order in person
qs.exp: 收據上有 Business customer discount (10%)＝享有企業客戶折扣。紙是 3 箱；收納盒還沒收費，所以不是全部先付了。

qs.q: What will most likely happen by October 17?
opts: A new order will be placed
The price of ink will increase
qs.exp: 附註說收納盒目前缺貨，10 月 17 日前另外寄出（shipped）＝部分商品會寄出。

p7.title: 單篇：電子郵件
passages:
To: Rachel Owens
From: Hiroshi Tanaka
Date: February 2
Subject: Quarterly review meeting

Dear Rachel,

Thank you for agreeing to present the customer satisfaction results at next Tuesday's quarterly review. The meeting will begin at 9:30 A.M. in the main conference room, and you will be the second speaker, after Mr. Bell from finance.

Each presenter has fifteen minutes, followed by five minutes for questions. The room has a projector, but please e-mail your slides to my assistant, Dana, by Monday at noon so that she can load them onto the laptop in advance.

If you need any printed handouts, Dana can arrange those as well.

Best regards,
Hiroshi Tanaka

qs.q: Why was the e-mail sent?
opts: To give details about a presentation
To invite Ms. Owens to a job interview
To ask Ms. Owens to conduct a survey
qs.exp: 信中感謝她答應在季度檢討會上報告，並說明時間、順序、長度＝說明簡報的細節。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Bell?
opts: He will speak before Ms. Owens
qs.exp: 她是第二位講者，排在財務部的 Bell 先生之後＝Bell 先生先講。助理是 Dana。

qs.q: What is Ms. Owens asked to do by Monday?
opts: Send her slides to an assistant
qs.exp: 請她週一中午前把投影片寄給助理 Dana（e-mail your slides to my assistant）。

p7.title: 單篇：報導（插入句子位置題）
passages:
City Opens First Electric Bus Route

GREENFIELD (June 4) — Greenfield's first fully electric bus route began service on Monday, connecting the train station with the university campus. [1]

The twelve new buses can travel about 250 kilometers on a single charge and are recharged overnight at the city's main depot. [2] Officials say the buses will save the city around $400,000 a year in fuel costs.

Riders have also noticed a difference. [3] "It's so quiet that you can actually have a conversation," said student Mia Torres. The city plans to convert three more routes to electric buses by the end of next year. [4]

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
opts: A new type of public transportation
The opening of a new train station near the campus
qs.exp: 報導 Greenfield 第一條全電動公車路線開始營運。

qs.q: According to the article, how will the city benefit?
opts: It will spend less on fuel
It will receive a government award
qs.exp: 官員說每年可以省下約 40 萬美元的燃料費（save … in fuel costs）。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Unlike the old diesel buses, the new ones make almost no noise."
qs.exp: 前一句說乘客也感受到差異，這句說明差異是什麼（幾乎沒有噪音），後面學生又說「安靜到可以聊天」，放在 [3] 最連貫。

p7.title: 單篇：線上課程網頁
passages:
BIZSKILLS ONLINE — Spring Courses

Business Writing (6 weeks) — $180
Learn to write clear e-mails, reports, and proposals. Includes weekly feedback from an instructor.

Data Analysis Basics (8 weeks) — $240
An introduction to spreadsheets, charts, and simple statistics. No previous experience required.

Presentation Skills (4 weeks) — $150
Practice delivering presentations in live online sessions every Thursday evening.

All courses begin on March 3. Students who register for two or more courses receive 20% off the total price. Certificates are issued to students who complete all assignments.

qs.q: Which course includes live sessions?
qs.exp: Presentation Skills 每週四晚上有線上直播課程（live online sessions）。

qs.q: What is true about Data Analysis Basics?
opts: It begins later than the other courses
qs.exp: No previous experience required＝適合初學者。最短的是四週的簡報課；每週回饋是寫作課的；所有課程都 3 月 3 日開始。

qs.q: How can students receive a discount?
opts: By taking more than one course
qs.exp: 報名兩門以上打八折（two or more courses receive 20% off）。完成作業拿到的是證書，不是折扣。

p7.title: 單篇：信件（插入句子位置題）
passages:
Harbor View Apartments
22 Ocean Drive, Bayside

April 18

Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Thank you for renting with Harbor View Apartments for the past two years. Your current lease will end on June 30. [1]

If you would like to stay, please sign the enclosed renewal form and return it to the management office by May 15. [2] The monthly rent for a new one-year lease will be $1,350, an increase of $50, which reflects rising maintenance costs.

We are also pleased to let you know that the fitness room on the ground floor will reopen in May after renovation. [3] It now has new equipment and longer opening hours.

If you plan to move out, please give us written notice by the same date. [4] We would be sorry to see you go.

Sincerely,
Karen Doyle
Property Manager

qs.q: Why did Ms. Doyle write to Mr. Alvarez?
opts: To ask whether he will renew his lease
To remind him of a late payment
To welcome him as a new tenant
To announce that the building will be sold
qs.exp: 信中說他的租約 6 月 30 日到期，要續約請簽續約表＝詢問是否續租。他已經住了兩年，不是新房客。

qs.q: What is indicated about the rent?
opts: It is due on the fifteenth of each month
It includes the cost of the fitness room
qs.exp: 新租約月租 $1,350，比原本多 $50＝小幅調漲。5 月 15 日是回覆期限，不是繳租日。

qs.q: What is mentioned about the fitness room?
opts: It is open only to new tenants
qs.exp: 健身房整修後五月重新開放，有新器材、開放時間更長＝已經更新。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This will give us time to arrange a final inspection of your apartment."
qs.exp: [4] 前面說「若要搬走，請在同一日期前書面通知」，接著說明提早通知的原因：「讓我們有時間安排退租檢查」。放在 [2] 時前面講的是續約，續約不需要退租檢查。

p7.title: 單篇：線上討論（意圖題）
passages:
Liam Carter [2:05 P.M.]
Team, the client in Toronto wants to move our video call from Thursday to Wednesday at 4:00. Does that work for everyone?

Nadia Rahman [2:07 P.M.]
I have a dentist appointment at 3:30 on Wednesday.

Owen Brooks [2:08 P.M.]
Wednesday is fine for me. Nadia, could you join from your phone after the appointment?

Nadia Rahman [2:10 P.M.]
Probably, but I'd be about fifteen minutes late. I'm the one presenting the budget, though.

Liam Carter [2:12 P.M.]
Then let's ask them for 4:30 instead. I'll e-mail them now and send everyone the new link once it's confirmed.

Owen Brooks [2:13 P.M.]
Sounds good. I'll update the slides tonight.

qs.q: What is the main topic of the discussion?
qs.exp: 客戶想把視訊會議改到週三，大家討論時間＝會議改期。

qs.q: At 2:10 P.M., why does Ms. Rahman write, "I'm the one presenting the budget, though"?
opts: To point out that her arrival time matters
To ask someone else to present
To offer to prepare more slides for the client
qs.exp: 意圖題：她說可能會晚十五分鐘，接著提醒預算是她要報告的，暗示她遲到會影響會議。Carter 先生因此改請客戶延到 4:30。

qs.q: What will Mr. Carter most likely do next?
qs.exp: 他說 I'll e-mail them now（現在就寫信給客戶）。更新投影片的是 Brooks 先生。

qs.q: What time does Mr. Carter suggest for the call?
qs.exp: 他說 let's ask them for 4:30 instead。3:30 是看牙醫的時間；4:00 是客戶原本提議的時間。

p7.title: 單篇：報導（同義字題）
passages:
Local Farm Expands into Tourism

WESTWOOD (August 12) — For three generations, the Hollis family has grown apples on its 40-hectare farm outside Westwood. This autumn, the family is opening its doors to visitors.

Starting September 1, guests can pick their own apples, take a guided tour of the orchard, and visit a new farm shop selling cider, jam, and baked goods. "Many families tell us they want their children to see where food comes from," said owner Peter Hollis. "This is our chance to share what we do."

The farm will be open on weekends from 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. through the end of October. Admission is $8 for adults and free for children under 12. Mr. Hollis expects the new activities to bring in additional income during a period when apple prices have been unstable.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
opts: A farm offering new activities for visitors
The sale of a family business
qs.exp: Hollis 家的果園開放遊客採果、導覽、農場商店＝農場推出新的遊客活動。

qs.q: According to Mr. Hollis, why are some families interested in visiting?
opts: They want their children to see food production
They want to buy land in the area
They are looking for seasonal jobs at local farms
qs.exp: 他說很多家庭希望孩子看看食物從哪裡來（see where food comes from）。

qs.q: In paragraph 2, the word "share" is closest in meaning to
qs.exp: 同義字題：share what we do 是「分享、讓人看到我們做的事」，最接近 show。divide 是「平分」的意思，在這裡不合。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned about the farm?
opts: It has been run by one family for decades
It will charge an admission fee
qs.exp: NOT 題：文中提到三代經營、成人門票 $8、商店賣烘焙點心，沒有提到住宿。

p7.title: 雙篇：徵才廣告＋應徵信
passages:
JOB OPENING: Customer Service Supervisor
Northgate Electronics — Denver store

We are looking for an experienced supervisor to lead our team of eight customer service representatives.

Requirements:
• At least three years of customer service experience, including one year in a supervisory role
• Excellent communication skills
• Availability to work weekends
• Spanish language skills are a plus

To apply, send a résumé and cover letter to jobs@northgate.com by November 20. Interviews will take place the week of November 27.

To: jobs@northgate.com
From: Teresa Vargas
Date: November 14
Subject: Customer Service Supervisor position

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Customer Service Supervisor position at your Denver store. For the past four years, I have worked at Belmont Home Appliances, where I was promoted to team leader eighteen months ago. In that role, I manage a team of six and handle customer complaints that require special attention.

I grew up speaking both English and Spanish, and I regularly assist our Spanish-speaking customers. I am available to work any day of the week.

Please note that I will be traveling from November 26 to December 1, but I would be happy to interview by video during that time.

Sincerely,
Teresa Vargas

qs.q: What is indicated about the position?
opts: The supervisor will manage eight people
It is located at several stores
qs.exp: 廣告說要帶領八位客服人員（lead our team of eight）。

qs.q: What is a requirement for the job?
qs.exp: 需要至少一年的主管經驗。西班牙語是加分項（a plus），不是必要條件。

qs.q: How long has Ms. Vargas been a team leader?
opts: About a year and a half
qs.exp: 她說十八個月前升為組長（eighteen months ago）＝約一年半。四年是她在該公司的總年資。

qs.q: Why does Ms. Vargas mention her travel plans?
opts: She will be away during the interview week
She wants to transfer to another city
She will start a new job at another company in December
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：廣告說面試在 11 月 27 日那週；她 11 月 26 日到 12 月 1 日出差，剛好在面試週，所以提議視訊面試。

qs.q: Which of Ms. Vargas's qualifications is described as a plus in the job opening?
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：廣告中標示為加分項（a plus）的是西班牙語能力，她說從小說英語和西班牙語。週末上班和主管經驗是必要條件，不是加分項。

p7.title: 雙篇：研討會議程＋電子郵件
passages:
REGIONAL RETAIL SUMMIT — Day 2 Program (Hall B)

9:00 A.M. — Keynote: The Future of In-Store Shopping (Dr. Amy Lin)
10:30 A.M. — Panel: Managing Online Returns
12:00 P.M. — Lunch (Terrace Restaurant)
1:30 P.M. — Workshop: Building Customer Loyalty (Raj Patel)
3:00 P.M. — Workshop: Pricing in Uncertain Times (Lisa Grant)
4:30 P.M. — Closing remarks

Workshops are limited to 40 participants. Please sign up at the registration desk.

To: Summit Organizers
From: Daniel Shaw
Date: May 9
Subject: Day 2 workshops

Hello,

I attended yesterday's sessions and found them very useful. I would like to join the workshop on customer loyalty this afternoon, but I was told at the registration desk that it is already full.

Could you let me know whether a recording or the slides will be made available afterward? My company has asked me to report on loyalty programs to our management team next week.

Also, I have to leave for the airport at 2:30 P.M., so unfortunately I will miss the other afternoon workshop as well.

Thank you,
Daniel Shaw

qs.q: What is true about the workshops?
opts: The number of participants is limited
They are held in the Terrace Restaurant
They take place in the morning
qs.exp: 議程說工作坊限 40 人（limited to 40 participants）。餐廳是午餐地點；工作坊在下午。

qs.q: Who is leading the workshop Mr. Shaw wants to attend?
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：他想參加顧客忠誠度的工作坊，議程上 Building Customer Loyalty 是 Raj Patel 主持。

qs.q: Why did Mr. Shaw write the e-mail?
opts: To ask about materials from a session
To register for a keynote speech
To offer to give a presentation at next year's summit
qs.exp: 工作坊已額滿，他問之後會不會提供錄影或投影片＝詢問課程資料。

qs.q: Why is Mr. Shaw interested in the topic?
opts: He has to report on it at work
He is writing a book about it
He plans to start his own business
He was asked to lead the workshop
qs.exp: 公司要他下週向管理團隊報告會員忠誠方案（report on loyalty programs）。

qs.q: Which session will Mr. Shaw be unable to attend because of his travel plans?
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：他兩點半要去機場，所以會錯過「另一場下午工作坊」。忠誠度那場是因為額滿；另一場下午工作坊是 3:00 的 Pricing in Uncertain Times。

p7.title: 三篇：產品網頁＋訂單確認＋顧客來信
passages:
COMFORTPRO OFFICE CHAIRS

opts: Brightline Design Studio is a regular customer
There was a special promotion in March
The chairs were assembled by the customer

p7.title: 三篇：備忘錄＋課表＋電子郵件
passages:

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?

To introduce a new HR director
To ask employees to update their contact details

opts: By attending ten or more classes
By reserving a spot before January 15

p7.title: 三篇：報導＋讀者評論＋電子郵件
passages:
Riverside Market Reopens After Renovation

FAIRVIEW (October 3) — The historic Riverside Market reopened on Saturday after an eight-month renovation. The market now has a glass roof, a seating area for 200 people, and twelve new food stalls. "We wanted to keep the character of the building while making it more comfortable," said market manager Jorge Silva. The market is open Tuesday through Sunday, from 8 A.M. to 8 P.M.

Review by Hannah P. — ★★★★☆
I visited Riverside Market last Sunday with my family. The new glass roof makes the whole space bright, and the food was excellent, especially the Thai noodle stall. My only complaint is parking. We drove around for twenty minutes before finding a space. Next time, I'll take the bus.

To: Jorge Silva
From: Councillor Ruth Ames
Date: October 15
Subject: Parking at Riverside Market

Dear Mr. Silva,

Congratulations on the successful reopening. Since then, my office has received several comments from residents about parking near the market, especially on weekends.

The city is willing to open the lot at the Fairview Library, two streets away, to market visitors on Saturdays and Sundays. Would you be available to meet next week to discuss how we could let visitors know about this option?

Best regards,
Ruth Ames

qs.q: What is mentioned about Riverside Market?
opts: It has a new parking garage
It was built eight months ago
qs.exp: 報導說市場週二到週日營業＝週一休息。八個月是整修期間，不是興建時間。

qs.q: What did Hannah P. like about the market?
qs.exp: 她說新的玻璃屋頂讓整個空間很明亮（bright）。停車是她唯一的抱怨。

qs.q: What problem do the review and the e-mail both mention?
qs.exp: 雙篇整合：評論抱怨找停車位花了二十分鐘；議員的信也說收到居民對停車的意見。

qs.q: What does Ms. Ames propose?
opts: Letting market visitors use another parking area
Extending the market's opening hours on weekend evenings
qs.exp: 市府願意在週末開放兩條街外的圖書館停車場給市場訪客＝讓訪客使用其他停車場。

qs.q: What problem experienced by Hannah P. is Ms. Ames's proposal intended to solve?
opts: Spending a long time looking for parking
Waiting in long lines at food stalls
Finding the market closed on Sunday
Having to pay high bus fares
qs.exp: 三篇整合：Hannah 說繞了二十分鐘才找到停車位；議員提議週末開放圖書館停車場給訪客，正是要解決找車位的問題。市場週日有營業；評論沒有提到排隊或公車票價。
